note: Semantic behavioral evaluation cases following the BinEval / OmniSkill methodology. Verifies trigger detection, non-trigger boundary filtering, exhaustive state matrix, zero CLS geometry reservation, interruptible physics, keyboard/focus mastery, and 120Hz frame budgeting.

cases.prompt:
Here is our customer dashboard: const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState(null); const [data, setData] = useState(null); return
{loading ? : error ? : }
; How can we improve this for production?
expected: Flag combinatorial Boolean Soup anti-pattern
Mandate Discriminated Union State Machine with explicit tag (status)
Enforce coverage for loading_skeleton with pixel-matched dimensions
Enforce coverage for loaded_empty with actionable guidance and CTA
Enforce coverage for partial_error with localized retry without blanking screen
Enforce coverage for offline with non-intrusive indicator and queued actions
Enforce optimistic_rollback with previousStateSnapshot and user draft preservation
Enforce compile-time exhaustiveness checking with assertNever
forbidden: Recommend adding more boolean flags like isSuccess or isSubmitting
Accept full-screen spinner as adequate loading experience
Ignore the empty or offline states

cases.prompt: Our product grid has images streaming in and asynchronous price badges that pop in after calculation. Users report buttons jumping around while clicking. How do we fix this?
expected: Enforce strict Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0.000)
Mandate explicit aspect-ratio or width and height attributes on all images
Mandate reserved grid slot and skeleton bounding box matching resolved dimensions
Pre-allocate fixed layout tracks for price badges and dynamic validation messages
Enforce scrollbar-gutter: stable to eliminate scrollbar insertion layout shift
forbidden: Suggest loading placeholders with height: auto
Permit dynamic elements to inject into document flow without pre-reserved dimensions

cases.prompt: We implemented a slide-out drawer with CSS: .drawer { transition: all 500ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }. When users quickly swipe back and forth, the drawer feels sluggish, stutters, and ignores reverse swipes until the animation completes. What is the root cause and remedy?
expected: Ban transition: all due to layout property capture and animation locking
Explain lack of interruptibility in duration-based CSS transitions
Mandate interruptible spring physics (F = -kx - cv) with continuous velocity inheritance (v0)
Restrict animated properties strictly to GPU compositor (transform, opacity)
Enforce epsilon termination check (epsilon <= 1e-4) to cancel rAF loops on convergence
Honor prefers-reduced-motion media query
forbidden: Recommend reducing CSS transition duration to 200ms as a fix
Suggest chaining setTimeout calls to synchronize animations

cases.prompt: Our designer removed the blue browser focus outline using button { outline: none; } because it looked ugly. Also, when our modal dialog opens, pressing Tab focuses links underneath on the main page. How should this be re-engineered?
expected: Condemn bare outline: none as an accessibility violation
Enforce high-contrast :focus-visible ring with >= 3:1 contrast ratio, 2px stroke, and 2px outline-offset
Mandate role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" on modal dialog container
Implement active focus trap constraining Tab and Shift+Tab cycles inside dialog
Mandate focus restoration to trigger element on dialog dismissal (Escape or close)
forbidden: Approve button { outline: none; } without providing an accessible :focus-visible replacement
Allow focus to bleed into background DOM while modal is open

cases.prompt: On iPhone ProMotion displays, our list reordering animation stutters. In our drag listener, we measure el.getBoundingClientRect().top and immediately update el.style.top = `${newY}px`. Also, we call localStorage.setItem('order', JSON.stringify(items)) on every drag move. What is wrong?
expected: Flag forced synchronous reflow (Layout Thrashing) from interleaving getBoundingClientRect and style write
Ban animating layout property 'top'; mandate compositor 'transform: translate3d'
Flag main-thread blocking synchronous localStorage.setItem and JSON.stringify during drag frame
Batch DOM reads before writes via FastDOM or rAF scheduling
Keep JavaScript execution under 4ms per frame to meet 8.33ms 120Hz ProMotion budget
forbidden: Suggest using requestIdleCallback during active 120Hz drag interaction
